dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual, symmetrical 2D narrowing of the visible body mass from the mid-dorsal region toward the posterior terminus.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Predominantly smooth lateral margins with a localized structural deviation on the right side where the profile briefly widens before continuing its taper.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Light bluish-grey skin tone, positioned between slate dark-grey and mature white.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Low-frequency distribution of diffuse, darker grey clusters concentrated primarily on the lower half of the visible dorsal surface.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse gradient transitions observed between the primary light-grey baseline and the localized mottled patches.

other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced, dark-pigmented longitudinal dorsal ridge extending along the central axis.
